description: This file defines the SagemakerChatHandler class, which manages the interaction with AWS SageMaker for chat-based large language model requests. It includes methods for loading AWS credentials, preparing HTTP requests with proper AWS signature authentication, and executing the chat completion process, integrating with other components such as OpenAILikeChatHandler and AWS event stream decoders.
